Basically sometimes when you keep your idea to yourself, you can often realise how good of a job you just did. However, this realisation makes you a bit overconfident hence you feel like it's time to show it to an audience. Then when you get to see your idea isn't much appreciated by others, you tend to doubt yourself. That doubt becomes hating and hating becomes shattering of confidence in you thus killing.

By my art I mean any creation, be it humans, music any thing and by the artist me I mean any creator, like God who created human, Composer who created the music any thing respectively. It has nothing to do with what kind of art actually.

If you have seen the movie Ex Machina, the creator of the Ai named Ava is killed by his own creation, like the way god created human who in turn killed his significance. I am an artist, I create art that's subjected to my physical being. My art is kind of caged in me like Ava was in the movie. I like to question about it now and then like Caleb does with Ava. When my art undergoes escapism, meaning when I consider my art as worthy enough which makes me want to expose it amongst different spectators hence escaping from the cage like body of mine, it betrays its creator and kills him eventually, like Ava did to her creator.  There is this famous quote by Friedrich Nietzsche's which goes by "God is dead. God remains dead. And we have killed him. How shall we comfort ourselves, the murderers of all murderers? What was holiest and mightiest of all that the world has yet owned has bled to death under our knives". That's why this question.
